phase_title: Phase 16 検証結果の受領・整合確認設計
phase_purpose: Phase 16（実測入力受領・検証層）の検証結果（Phase 16-7 統合検証レポート、Phase 16-8 実行可否判定レポート）を受けて、その完全性・形式・整合性を確認し、Phase 15-7/15-8 測定ワークフローへの引き渡し準備を整える。受け取った検証結果が有効で矛盾がないかを検証する最終手前ゲートを設計する。
execution_context: reports-only design phase; design of Phase 16 result receipt and consistency validation structure only, no actual result receipt or validation yet

governance.safety_rule: All blocked_actions remain strictly prohibited. Phase 16 result receipt and consistency validation is design-only; no actual receipt or validation occurs. No app/tests implementation permitted.
governance.hard_stop_condition: This phase is design-only. No actual Phase 16 result processing occurs.

phase16_result_receipt_purpose.purpose: Receive and validate Phase 16 design completion outputs (Phase 16-7 unified validation result report design, Phase 16-8 workflow execution feasibility judgment design, Phase 16-9 completion declaration) and confirm they are complete, consistent, and ready for handoff to Phase 15-7/15-8 measurement workflows
receipt_inputs: Phase 16-7 validation result report design artifact
Phase 16-8 workflow execution feasibility judgment design artifact
All 6 prior Phase 16 design artifacts (16-1 through 16-6)
receipt_outputs: Phase 17-1 Phase 16 result receipt and consistency confirmation report determining: RECEIPT_CONFIRMED_AND_CONSISTENT, RECEIPT_CONFIRMED_WITH_WARNINGS, or RECEIPT_FAILED_INCONSISTENCY
phase16_result_receipt_purpose.downstream_consumer: Phase 17-2 (Phase 15-7 integrated_decision measurement workflow execution feasibility) and Phase 17-3 (Phase 15-8 receiver_validator_permission measurement workflow execution feasibility)

requirement_group_1_all_artifacts_presen.requirement: All 9 Phase 16 design artifacts (16-1 through 16-9) must be present and accessible
requirement_group_1_all_artifacts_presen.completeness_check_logic: ALL 9 artifacts must be present; if ANY artifact missing, receipt_status = RECEIPT_FAILED

requirement_group_2_json_validity.requirement: All Phase 16 design artifacts must be valid JSON and parseable without errors
requirement_group_2_json_validity.verification_procedure: Parse each artifact as JSON; if any parse error occurs, receipt_status = RECEIPT_FAILED
requirement_group_2_json_validity.check_logic: FOR EACH artifact: attempt json.load() or equivalent; if any fails, overall_json_validity = FAILED

requirement_group_3_structural_consisten.requirement: All Phase 16 artifacts must maintain consistent governance and safety structure (_meta, governance, status blocks)
requirement_group_3_structural_consisten.consistency_check_logic: All consistency elements must match across all 9 artifacts; if ANY mismatch detected, consistency_status = INCONSISTENT

requirement_group_4_state_consistency.requirement: All Phase 16 artifacts must maintain consistent NO_GO and NOT_EFFECTIVE state declarations
requirement_group_4_state_consistency.state_consistency_check_logic: All state values must be consistent across all 9 artifacts; if ANY inconsistency detected, state_consistency_status = INCONSISTENT

requirement_group_5_dependency_reference.requirement: Phase 16-7, 16-8, 16-9 must explicitly reference their upstream dependencies (Phase 16-1 through 16-6, plus intermediate artifacts)

phase_16_7_references.check_logic: Verify phase_16_7 'depends_on' field lists these dependencies

phase_16_8_references.check_logic: Verify phase_16_8 'depends_on' field lists these dependencies

phase_16_9_references.check_logic: Verify phase_16_9 'verification_1_all_sub_phases_designed' section lists all 8 sub-phases

step_1_artifact_presence_check.action: Verify all 9 Phase 16 artifacts exist and are accessible
step_1_artifact_presence_check.condition: All 9 files must be found; if any missing, halt with receipt_status = RECEIPT_FAILED

step_2_json_validity_check.action: Parse each artifact as JSON; verify no syntax errors
step_2_json_validity_check.condition: All 9 must parse successfully; if any parse error, halt with receipt_status = RECEIPT_FAILED

step_3_governance_consistency_check.action: Verify _meta and governance blocks are consistent across all 9 artifacts
step_3_governance_consistency_check.condition: All consistency checks must pass; if any fail, halt with receipt_status = RECEIPT_FAILED_INCONSISTENCY

step_4_state_consistency_check.action: Verify status blocks are consistent: NO_GO/NOT_EFFECTIVE/NO_GO/NO_GO across all 9 artifacts
step_4_state_consistency_check.condition: All state checks must pass; if any mismatch, halt with receipt_status = RECEIPT_FAILED_INCONSISTENCY

step_5_dependency_reference_check.action: Verify Phase 16-7, 16-8, 16-9 explicitly reference their upstream dependencies
step_5_dependency_reference_check.condition: All dependency references must be present and correct; if any missing, flag as receipt_status = RECEIPT_CONFIRMED_WITH_WARNINGS

step_6_phase16_9_completion_checklist_va.action: Review Phase 16-9 completion verification items (verification_1 through verification_5)
verify_items: All 8 sub-phases (16-1 through 16-8) are listed and marked verified
Design completeness checklist shows all coverage items complete
step_6_phase16_9_completion_checklist_va.condition: All verification items in Phase 16-9 must show VERIFIED status; if any unverified, flag as receipt_status = RECEIPT_CONFIRMED_WITH_WARNINGS

step_7_handoff_readiness_confirmation.action: Confirm Phase 16 design is ready for handoff to Phase 15-7/15-8
readiness_markers: All blocking conditions from Phase 16-3 can be checked at Phase 17-2/17-3 entry
step_7_handoff_readiness_confirmation.condition: Handoff readiness must be confirmed; proceed to determine overall receipt status

step_8_synthesize_receipt_status.action: Synthesize all checks into overall receipt_status
step_8_synthesize_receipt_status.logic: IF (presence_ok AND json_ok AND governance_consistent AND state_consistent AND dependency_refs_present) THEN receipt_status = RECEIPT_CONFIRMED_AND_CONSISTENT; ELSE IF (minor_warnings_only) THEN receipt_status = RECEIPT_CONFIRMED_WITH_WARNINGS; ELSE receipt_status = RECEIPT_FAILED_INCONSISTENCY

step_9_generate_receipt_confirmation_rep.action: Generate Phase 17-1 result receipt and consistency confirmation report

elements.artifacts_missing: List of artifacts NOT found (should be empty)

elements.artifacts_parsed_successfully: Count of artifacts that parsed as valid JSON
elements.artifacts_parse_failed: Count of artifacts with JSON syntax errors
elements.parse_error_details: Details of any parse failures (artifact name, error type, line number if available)

operation_mode_consistency.verified: boolean - all 9 artifacts have operation_mode = OBSERVE

execution_consistency.verified: boolean - all 9 artifacts have execution = dry_run

production_status_consistency.verified: boolean - all 9 artifacts have production_status = NO_GO (in both _meta and status blocks)

blocked_actions_consistency.verified: boolean - all 9 artifacts have blocked_actions array of exactly 10 items

requires_human_approval_consistency.verified: boolean - all 9 artifacts have requires_human_approval = true

auto_execute_allowed_consistency.verified: boolean - all 9 artifacts have auto_execute_allowed = false

changed_area_consistency.verified: boolean - all 9 artifacts have changed_area = 'reports only'

elements.inconsistency_details: If any inconsistency detected, list artifact name and inconsistent value

integrated_decision_status_check.artifacts_with_correct_value: Count of artifacts with integrated_decision_status = NO_GO
integrated_decision_status_check.artifacts_with_incorrect_value: List of any artifacts NOT having NO_GO (should be empty)

receiver_validator_permission_status_che.artifacts_with_correct_value: Count of artifacts with receiver_validator_permission_status = NOT_EFFECTIVE
receiver_validator_permission_status_che.artifacts_with_incorrect_value: List of any artifacts NOT having NOT_EFFECTIVE (should be empty)

app_implementation_status_check.artifacts_with_correct_value: Count of artifacts with app_implementation_status = NO_GO
app_implementation_status_check.artifacts_with_incorrect_value: List of any artifacts NOT having NO_GO (should be empty)

tests_implementation_status_check.artifacts_with_correct_value: Count of artifacts with tests_implementation_status = NO_GO
tests_implementation_status_check.artifacts_with_incorrect_value: List of any artifacts NOT having NO_GO (should be empty)

phase_16_7_dependencies.found_in_depends_on: List of dependencies found in phase_16_7 'depends_on' field
phase_16_7_dependencies.missing_dependencies: List of expected dependencies NOT found

phase_16_8_dependencies.missing_dependencies: List of expected dependencies NOT found

expected_references: Verification checklists for all 5 verification groups
phase_16_9_dependencies.missing_dependencies: List of expected sub-phases NOT referenced

verification_1_all_sub_phases_designed.status_in_phase16_9: Expected: VERIFIED - All 8 artifacts present and approved

verification_2_design_completeness.status_in_phase16_9: Expected: VERIFIED - All workflow stages covered

verification_3_no_implementation_changes.status_in_phase16_9: Expected: VERIFIED - Phase 16 design-only (no implementation files changed)

verification_4_no_go_state_maintained.status_in_phase16_9: Expected: VERIFIED - All NO_GO/NOT_EFFECTIVE states maintained

verification_5_phase16_design_consistenc.status_in_phase16_9: Expected: VERIFIED - All files maintain consistent governance and safety structure

elements.all_verification_items_verified: boolean - true if all 5 verification items show VERIFIED

elements.handoff_checklist_items_passed: Count of checklist items with status PASS
elements.handoff_checklist_all_items_passed: boolean - true if all 12 items show PASS

logic.RECEIPT_CONFIRMED_AND_CONSISTENT: All 5 verification groups pass: artifacts present, JSON valid, governance consistent, state consistent, dependencies referenced; Phase 16-9 completion verified; handoff ready
logic.RECEIPT_CONFIRMED_WITH_WARNINGS: Artifacts present and JSON valid, but minor inconsistencies flagged (e.g., dependency reference incomplete); Phase 16 design still usable for Phase 17-2/17-3 but with caution
logic.RECEIPT_FAILED_INCONSISTENCY: Critical inconsistencies detected (artifacts missing, JSON invalid, governance mismatch, state mismatch); cannot proceed to Phase 17-2/17-3

logic.DO_NOT_PROCEED: If RECEIPT_FAILED_INCONSISTENCY; halt and investigate before proceeding

phase17_2_phase17_3_handoff_condition.description: State at the moment Phase 17-2 and Phase 17-3 can enter

elements.phase16_result_receipt_confirmed: boolean - true if overall_receipt_and_consistency_status in [RECEIPT_CONFIRMED_AND_CONSISTENT, RECEIPT_CONFIRMED_WITH_WARNINGS]
elements.phase16_artifacts_verified: boolean - all 9 artifacts present, JSON valid, consistent
elements.phase16_design_layer_complete: boolean - confirmed by Phase 16-9 completion declaration
elements.phase17_2_entry_timestamp: Time at which Phase 17-2 begins (if approved)
elements.phase17_3_entry_timestamp: Time at which Phase 17-3 begins (if approved, typically same as Phase 17-2)

depends_on: Phase 16-1 through Phase 16-9: All Phase 16 design artifacts must exist and be complete
feeds_into: Phase 17-2: Phase 15-7 integrated_decision measurement workflow execution feasibility (receives Phase 16 receipt confirmation)
Phase 17-3: Phase 15-8 receiver_validator_permission measurement workflow execution feasibility (receives Phase 16 receipt confirmation)

design_review_checklist: Receipt validation covers all 5 completeness requirement groups (artifacts, JSON, governance, state, dependencies)
Artifact presence check requires all 9 Phase 16 artifacts
JSON validity verification handles parse errors gracefully
Governance consistency check verifies 7 structural elements across all artifacts
State consistency check verifies 4 state values across all artifacts
Dependency reference verification confirms Phase 16-7, 16-8, 16-9 cross-references
Phase 16-9 completion checklist validation reviews all 5 verification items
Handoff readiness confirmation extracted from Phase 16-9 status
Receipt status logic (CONFIRMED/WARNINGS/FAILED) flows from check results
Recommended next action (PROCEED/CAUTION/HALT) maps to receipt status
Phase 17-2/17-3 handoff condition explicitly defines entry preconditions
All blocked actions remain in governance

completion_gate.gate_condition: Phase 16 result receipt and consistency validation design approved AND verification procedure finalized
completion_gate.approval_required: Human technical reviewer + Phase 17 design authority
completion_gate.prerequisite_for: Phase 17-2 (Phase 15-7 integrated_decision measurement workflow execution feasibility) and Phase 17-3 (Phase 15-8 receiver_validator_permission measurement workflow execution feasibility) can begin once Phase 16 result receipt is confirmed
